info.name: Ahlena Admin — Feedback
info.description: Portal second pass B3: the admin app-rating investigation read (GET /api/v1/admin/feedback/app-ratings). The route carries the shared OperationalReadAdmin policy — Normal access with account_type SuperAdmin (5) or SupportAdmin (7); ContentAdmin, FinanceAdmin and every app audience are denied with 403, and a missing or non-Normal token with 401. It is a read-only list over the ratings submitted through the authenticated app surface: items project exactly the stored columns (id, userId, rating 1-5, optional comment, deviceInfo, appVersion, createdOnUtc), newest-first by createdOnUtc then id, with no name, phone, email or contact data ever joined in. Paging follows the other paged admin reads and is clamped silently, never rejected: page below 1 is treated as 1 and pageSize below 1 or above 100 falls back to 20 (100 itself is accepted); an empty database returns 200 with items [] and totalCount 0. These examples are authored, not runtime evidence; run only against disposable local fixtures.

request.description: OperationalReadAdmin. Reads stored app ratings newest-first by createdOnUtc then id. The paged envelope is { items, page, pageSize, totalCount }; each item carries id, userId (the internal user id, the sole attribution), rating, comment (nullable), deviceInfo (nullable), appVersion (nullable) and createdOnUtc. A well-formed-submission database with no ratings yet returns 200 with an empty items array and totalCount 0 rather than an error.

exec: pm.test('app rating list contract status', () => pm.expect([200, 401, 403]).to.include(pm.response.code));

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('page'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('pageSize'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('totalCount'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('items').that.is.an('array'); body.items.forEach(item => { pm.expect(item.rating).to.be.within(1, 5); pm.expect(item).to.have.property('id'); pm.expect(item).to.have.property('userId'); pm.expect(item).to.have.property('createdOnUtc'); }); const raw = JSON.stringify(body); pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('email'); pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('phone'); pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('nameArabic'); pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('nameEnglish'); }

request.description: pageSize is honored up to 100; page 1 with pageSize 2 returns at most the two newest ratings while totalCount still counts every stored rating, so the next page holds the older ones. Run with pageSize=2&page=2 to walk the remainder; a page beyond the data returns an empty items array with the full totalCount preserved.

exec: pm.test('app rating split page contract', () => pm.expect([200, 401, 403]).to.include(pm.response.code));
if (pm.response.code === 200) { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.items.length).to.be.at.most(2); pm.expect(body.page).to.eql(1); pm.expect(body.pageSize).to.eql(2); }

item.name: List app ratings (out-of-range paging is clamped)

request.description: Unlike the moderated rating lists, this read clamps silently instead of validating: page 0 is treated as 1 and pageSize 1000 (above the 100 maximum) falls back to the 20 default, so the request still answers 200 with page=1 and pageSize=20 echoed in the body. A client cannot break the route with paging input.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.page).to.eql(1); pm.expect(body.pageSize).to.eql(20); }

item.name: Role denial is not an app-rating read

request.description: Only Normal access with account_type SuperAdmin (5) or SupportAdmin (7) passes the OperationalReadAdmin policy: ContentAdmin, FinanceAdmin, Care Home owners, Family, Elderly and Caregiver tokens are 403, and a missing, expired or non-Normal token is 401. A denied caller never receives a 200 page and the stored ratings stay invisible. Replace accessToken to exercise the denial.

exec: pm.test('app rating route is policy-guarded', () => pm.expect([200, 401, 403]).to.include(pm.response.code));
